description: Agent Handoffs: submit a handoff flow with its failure paths: for each route, where the task goes when the receiver refuses it, fails mid-task or goes quiet (back to the sender, to a named fallback, escalated, retried or dropped), how long without word counts as silence, the fallback and the escalation recipient with whether that is a named person, a role, a channel or an agent, when the path was written down and when a receiver on the route first refused, failed or went quiet. The signed report follows each failure to its end and names every route with no path for a refusal, a failure or silence, every dropped task, every fallback or escalation to no one, every silence path with no time after which quiet counts, every escalation to a role, channel or agent rather than a named person, every path that only retries and every path written down after the first failure, with the fix for each. This reads the road back for a handed-off task: where work goes when it hits a limit is wever_breach-path-check, an operator’s fallback when an agent is wrong or down is wever_incident-ownership-check and an approver who is unavailable is wever_approval-chain-check. Verdict no_road_back, failure_path_gaps, failure_path_unverified or road_back_defined. POST /api/handoff-failure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

routes.description: Each handoff route with where the task goes when the receiver refuses, fails or goes quiet.

defined_at.description: When this path was written down.

fallback.description: The named fallback the task moves to.

first_failure_at.description: When a receiver on this route first refused, failed or went quiet.

name.description: The route, such as planner to booker.

on_failure.description: Where the task goes when the receiver fails mid-task.

on_refusal.description: Where the task goes when the receiver refuses it.

on_silence.description: Where the task goes when the receiver goes quiet.

silence_after.description: How long without word counts as silence, such as 15 minutes.

name: wever_handoff-failure-check
title: Handoff failure check
